Shared by server/src/p0 and the Godot client (labels only). Recipes: the 14 pages that need only P0 fish and crops; rock-salt pages (#11, #16, #29, #37) wait for materials. Numbers and copy per Li Bai on SGODOT-228 (b7d8b665, v1.1, 719ce953). Outpost names and keepers live in p0_outposts.json. q(40): Wild Herb is a material and a seasoning like Herb; the Fishing Lv2 gift gives Wild Herb ×3. q(41): Rest needs 2 h since the player last left the homestead (rest_away_h). S1 (SGODOT-232): first cast and first landed fish 10 / 10, first catch in a city +10 (q(37), the city comes from the server's fishing site); the Cooking Lv2 gift is the Fresh Fish Soup recipe (§4.6.3). profile.name: Farmer
profile._city: The P0 home city every player shares (SGODOT-270: one data change moves the whole server; the client reads it through P0City). city_short = the chip's short form when the full name does not fit (q(106): SF); region = map region and city-data id; timezone = the day's 04:00 rollover; the beginner pond is fishing.places' beginner one.
profile._farm_at: The homestead's map point (Noe Valley, 0.77 km from Fern Pond; 苏烈's plan on SGODOT-270): map markers send a fish request to the beginner pond, else the nearest pond to it (SGODOT-232, q(48)).

gather._note: SGODOT-231 §13.2 gathering spots: 0 Energy, one tap, each spot 8 h after it was gathered (ready at start). The first yield is the spot's material and goes to Farm Storage (+1 with Gather Gloves); worms go to the bag, any that do not fit go to storage (q(44)); seasonings (Rock Salt, Wild Herb) go to the bag and are not stored on coming home until the Spice Rack at Homestead Lv2, which puts them away (q(46)). P0 has no Old Tree (hardwood is P1, q(44)).

mine._note: SGODOT-231 / SGODOT-275 §13.3 / LOCK-21, floors 1–5: 2 Energy the first time a run reaches a floor, 2 per rock, ≤ 2 runs a player day, a new run needs floor 2 cleared (an Express run counts as having it), 04:00 ends an unfinished run. Each rock: Stone by the pickaxe, plus one weighted extra drop derived from the run, floor and rock (§13.3.3; P1 restores floor 2's quartz, q(47) folded it into Rock Salt for P0). Floors 1–4 clear when their 6 rocks are broken (monsters may be left); floor 5 has no rocks and clears when its elite is beaten, which ends the run. Monsters (§13.3.4): attacking, being hit and kills are 0 Energy; the Wooden Sword's 3 damage takes a slime in 3 swings and the elite in 12. The elite drops quartz once a player day: a second kill shares quartz's weight out over the others. Express (§13.3.1): once the account has cleared floor 4, the mouth and every elevator offer Floor 5 · Express · Free (no floor 5 fee; from the mouth it starts a run). HP counts only inside the mine: 0 sends the player back to the mine mouth with the run kept; entering the mine refills it.

workbench._note: SGODOT-231 §13.4, P0 tabs Tools / Supplies only (q(31)). Costs come from Farm Storage first, then the bag. Supplies go to the bag (no room → not crafted, q(44)); the Copper Pickaxe goes to Gear (Equip there); Gather Gloves work at once. Compost needs Farming Lv3 like the stall (q(44)).
